recognition.summary: With permission, product reporters are credited in advisories or the recognition page when no advisory is published.

reporting.summary: Product reports use direct email or a first-party form; bounty opt-in asks for a Bugcrowd email.

rewards.summary: Eligible monetary awards are discretionary; the bounty payment process can involve an external platform.

limitations: This direct route concerns products; non-product corporate website reports use a separate external disclosure service.
The shared recognition page also includes corporate-infrastructure credits; that does not expand this entry's direct route.
Acknowledgment may be withheld in some circumstances. Coordinate disclosure and wait for remediation.
